senses.gloss:
N. of (1) the sage Bhāradvāja; (2) of Śatānanda, Gotama's son; (3) of Kṛpa, Droṇa's brother-in-law; (4) of Buddha; (5) of the propounder of the Nyāya system of philosophy. 
-Comp. 
-सम्भवा the river Godāvarī.

__1 N. of Kṛpī, wife of Droṇa. 
__2 An epithet of the Godāvarī. 
__3 The teaching of Buddha. 
__4 The Nyāya system of philosophy propounded by Gautama. 
__5 Turmeric. 
__6 A kind of yellow pigment. 
__7 An epithet of Durgā. 8 N. of the river Gomatī.
